name: [Full Release🔥] Project Bikelife
desc:
🏍️ Welcome to Project Bikelife 🏍️

Project Bikelife is a bike life game focused on **realistic physics, wheelies, combos, swerves, and clean bike control. Whether you’re trying to learn balance or hit crazy combos, this game is all about skill.

This game has a learning curve, so don’t expect to master it instantly. You’ll need to learn throttle control, brake control, speed control, and balance to really good.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

Features

🏍️ Realistic bike physics
🔥 Skill-based wheelies & combos
🚗 Dealership
💸 Make money riding or doing jobs
🔄 Bike trading
👤 Character creation + clothing imports
⭐ Limited bikes
🗺️ Big map with more coming

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

❗ NOTICE ❗
This game is still in early development
